## [I am having horrible experience with…](https://www.trustpilot.com/reviews/650a74a2a84cba683d129716)
I am having horrible experience with delivery. I bought a rug from the website. I was initially told that my rug will be delivered by FedEx but then some random delivery company (I was not never made aware of) tried to deliver it. Obviously I missed that delivery since they tried to deliver on Wednesday at 9 am when I was at work. Now this company scheduling but keep cancelling it on their own without informing me. They have cancelled on me twice already. This is huge inconvenience and unfair to take a day off from work just to be cancelled by the delivery company. This was very poorly communicated by Lulu and Georgia for such an expensive item.

I am posting this review since I have gotten ton of emails regarding posting a review rather than customer service replying to my filed report ( it has been more than 48 hours). Extremely poor customer service

September 5, 2023

* * *

Reply from Lulu and Georgia

Sep 20, 2023

Hi Hina,

We thank you for reaching out and we're sorry to hear about your experience with our delivery courier. We will get a representative to further assist you with this. If you have any further questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to reach out to support@luluandgeorgia.com.
